mapper.insert: insert into product_examine (id, user_id, product_id, vault, status, note, app_time,examine_id) VALUES (null,#{userId},#{productId},#{vault},#{status},#{note},#{appTime},#{examineId})
mapper.select: select * from ( select b.*,userName as examineName from ( select a.*,userName as appName from (select product_examine.*,product.name,material_number,description,product.parentId from product_examine left join product on product_examine.product_id = product.id and product_examine.vault = product.vault) as a left join user on a.user_id = user.id) as b left join user on user.id=b.examine_id union all select b.*,userName as examineName from ( select a.*,userName as appName from (select product_examine.*,fin_product.fin_product_name as name,fin_material_number as material_number,fin_description as description,fin_product.fin_sort_id as parentId from product_examine left join fin_product on product_examine.product_id = fin_product.id and product_examine.vault = fin_product.vault) as a left join user on a.user_id = user.id) as b left join user on user.id=b.examine_id ) as d where length(d.material_number) >0 ORDER BY FIELD(status,0,1,2), app_time desc

select a.*,attribute_name.name,unit from ( select attribute_content.* from (select id from product where id =#{productId} and vault = #{vault}) as c left join attribute_content on attribute_content.productId = c.id ) as a LEFT JOIN attribute_name on a.parentId = attribute_name.id union all select a.*,fin_attribute_name.fin_att_name as name,fin_att_unit as unit from ( select fin_attribute_content.* from (select id from fin_product where id =#{productId} and vault = #{vault}) as c left join fin_attribute_content on fin_attribute_content.fin_product_id = c.id ) as a LEFT JOIN fin_attribute_name on a.fin_att_name_id = fin_attribute_name.id

select * from ( select b.*,userName as examineName from ( select a.*,userName as appName from (select product_examine.*,product.name,material_number,description,parentId from product_examine left join product on product_examine.product_id = product.id and product_examine.vault = product.vault where user_id = #{userId}) as a left join user on a.user_id = user.id) as b left join user on user.id=b.examine_id union all select b.*,userName as examineName from ( select a.*,userName as appName from (select product_examine.*,fin_product.fin_product_name as name,fin_material_number as material_number,fin_description as description,fin_sort_id as parentId from product_examine left join fin_product on product_examine.product_id = fin_product.id and product_examine.vault = fin_product.vault where user_id = #{userId}) as a left join user on a.user_id = user.id) as b left join user on user.id=b.examine_id ) as d where length(d.material_number) >0 ORDER BY FIELD(status,0,1,2), app_time desc
